34790-perverted-proverbs-a-manual-of-imm.creator: Col. D. Streamer
34790-perverted-proverbs-a-manual-of-imm.description: A book by Col. D. Streamer. 'twixt you and me,  We have what makes amends;   And since I am so glad of you,   Be glad of me a little, too,  Because of being friends. And, if I earn your approbation,   Accept my humble dedication.

arxiv-2103-06151.title: Vector resonance X 1 ​ ( 2900 ) X_{1}(2900) and its structure
arxiv-2103-06151.creator: S. S. Agaev, K. Azizi, H. Sundu
arxiv-2103-06151.description: Abstract The new vector resonance X 1 ​ ( 2900 ) X_{1}(2900) observed recently by LHCb in the D − ​ K + D^{-}K^{+} invariant mass distribution in the decay B + → D + ​ D − ​ K + B^{+}\to D^{+}D^{-}K^{+} is studied to uncover internal structure of this state, and calculate its physical parameters.

arxiv-2210-13536.title: Effective Pre-Training Objectives for Transformer-based Autoencoders
arxiv-2210-13536.creator: Luca Di Liello, Matteo Gabburo, Alessandro Moschitti
arxiv-2210-13536.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Luca Di Liello, Matteo Gabburo, Alessandro Moschitti. In this paper, we study trade-offs between efficiency, cost and accuracy when pre-training Transformer encoders with different pre-training objectives. For this purpose, we analyze features of common objectives and combine them to create new effective pre-training approaches. Specifically, we designed light token generators based on a straightforward statistical approach, which can replace ELECTRA computationally heavy generators, thus highly reducing cost.

arxiv-2305-10732.title: BlindHarmony: “Blind” Harmonization for MR Images via Flow model
arxiv-2305-10732.creator: Hwihun JeongHeejoon ByunDong Un Kang, Jongho LeeDepartment of ECE, Seoul National University, Republic of Korea {hwihuni, ryanb01, qkrtnskfk23, jonghoyi}@snu.ac.kr
arxiv-2305-10732.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Hwihun JeongHeejoon ByunDong Un Kang, Jongho LeeDepartment of ECE, Seoul National University, Republic of Korea {hwihuni, ryanb01, qkrtnskfk23, jonghoyi}@snu.ac.kr. In MRI, images of the same contrast (e.g., T 1 ) from the same subject can exhibit noticeable differences when acquired using different hardware, sequences, or scan parameters. These differences in images create a domain gap that needs to be bridged by a step called image harmonization, to process the images successfully using conventional or deep learning-based image analysis (e.g., segmentation).

arxiv-2311-00961.title: Concatenated Masked Autoencoders as Spatial-Temporal Learner
arxiv-2311-00961.creator: Zhouqiang Jiang, Bowen Wang, Tong Xiang, Zhaofeng Niu, Hong Tang, Guangshun Li, Liangzhi Li
arxiv-2311-00961.description: Abstract Learning representations from videos requires understanding continuous motion and visual correspondence between frames. In this paper, we introduce the Concatenated Masked Autoencoders (CatMAE) as a spatial-temporal learner for self-supervised video representation learning. For the input sequence of video frames, CatMAE keeps the initial frame unchanged while applying substantial masking (95%) to subsequent frames.

arxiv-2408-11690.title: The off-equilibrium Kinetic Ising model: The Metric Case
arxiv-2408-11690.creator: Luca Di Carlo
arxiv-2408-11690.description: Abstract We investigate the critical behavior of the Kinetic Ising model with non-reciprocal nearest neighbors interactions. A finite-size scaling study suggests that the model belongs to the Ising universality class. We characterize the off-equilibrium behavior of the model by measuring the entropy production rate and by studying the coarsening dynamics, which shows a super-diffusive relaxation.

arxiv-2411-10808.title: FISTA Iterates Converge Linearly for Denoiser-Driven Regularization Thanks: Funding: A. Sinha was supported by PMRF Fellowship TF/PMRF-22-5534 and K. N. Chaudhury was supported by grants CRG/2020/000527 and STR/2021/000011 from the Government of India.
arxiv-2411-10808.creator: Arghya Sinha, Kunal N. Chaudhury
arxiv-2411-10808.description: Abstract The effectiveness of denoising-driven regularization for image reconstruction has been widely recognized. Two prominent algorithms in this area are Plug-and-Play ( PnP ) and Regularization-by-Denoising ( RED ). We consider two specific algorithms PnP-FISTA and RED-APG , where regularization is performed by replacing the proximal operator in the FISTA algorithm with a powerful denoiser.

arxiv-2503-14475.title: Optimized 3D Gaussian Splatting using Coarse-to-Fine Image Frequency Modulation
arxiv-2503-14475.creator: Umar Farooq, Jean-Yves Guillemaut, Graham Thomas, Adrian Hilton, Marco Volino
arxiv-2503-14475.description: Abstract . The field of Novel View Synthesis has been revolutionized by 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), which enables high-quality scene reconstruction that can be rendered in real-time. 3DGS-based techniques typically suffer from high GPU memory and disk storage requirements which limits their practical application on consumer-grade devices.

arxiv-2504-21807.title: Nonautonomous control systems and skew product flows
arxiv-2504-21807.creator: Fritz Colonius, Roberta Fabbri
arxiv-2504-21807.description: Abstract For nonautonomous control systems with compact control range, associated control flows are introduced. This leads to several skew product flows with various base spaces. The controllability and chain controllability properties are studied and related to properties of the associated skew product flows.

arxiv-2506-17400.title: Metal-polluted PopIII Galaxies and How to Find Them
arxiv-2506-17400.creator: Elka Rusta, Stefania Salvadori, Viola Gelli, Daniel Schaerer, Alessandro Marconi, Ioanna Koutsouridou, Stefano Carniani
arxiv-2506-17400.description: Abstract Observing Population III (PopIII) galaxies, the hosts of first-generation stars, remains challenging even with the JWST. The current few candidates have been identified through the combination of a prominent HeII emission and the absence of metal lines, a well-known but extremely brief signature of metal-free systems.

arxiv-2508-03524.title: Semantic Mosaicing of Histo-Pathology Image Fragments using Visual Foundation Models
arxiv-2508-03524.creator: Stefan Brandstätter stefan.brandstaetter@meduniwien.ac.at, Maximilan Köller maximilian.koeller@meduniwien.ac.at, Philipp Seeböck philipp.seeboeck@meduniwien.ac.at, Alissa Blessing alissa.blessing@meduniwien.ac.at, Felicitas Oberndorfer felicitas.oberndorfer@meduniwien.ac.at, Svitlana Pochepnia svitl
arxiv-2508-03524.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Stefan Brandstätter stefan.brandstaetter@meduniwien.ac.at, Maximilan Köller maximilian.koeller@meduniwien.ac.at, Philipp Seeböck philipp.seeboeck@meduniwien.ac.at, Alissa Blessing alissa.blessing@meduniwien.ac.at, Felicitas Oberndorfer felicitas.oberndorfer@meduniwien.ac.at, Svitlana Pochepnia svitl. In histopathology, tissue samples are often larger than a standard microscope slide, making stitching of multiple fragments necessary to process entire structures such as tumors. Automated stitching is a prerequisite for scaling analysis, but is challenging due to possible tissue loss during preparation, inhomogeneous morphological distortion, staining inconsistencies, missing regions due to misalignment on the slide, or frayed tissue edges.

pmc-10544321.creator: Yurong Huang, Qiuyun Xue, Jun Chang, Yuting Wang, Chenglong Cheng, Suowen Xu, Xiao Wang, Chenggui Miao

pmc-10997295.title: In need of percutaneous coronary intervention in an arctic setting– patients’ experience of safety and quality of care: a qualitative study
pmc-10997295.creator: Anette Krane, Gunn Pettersen, Knut Tore Lappegård, Tove Aminda Hanssen
pmc-10997295.description: Patients with coronary heart disease need timely treatment for survival and optimum prognosis. There is limited research exploring patients’ experience regarding distance to percutaneous coronary intervention. The aim was to explore patients’ experiences of aspects contributing to safety and quality of care regarding health services following percutaneous coronary intervention in Northern Norway.

pmc-11496889.title: The link between childhood traumatic events and the continuum of premenstrual disorders
pmc-11496889.creator: Lindsay R. Standeven, Mira Bajaj, Kathleen McEvoy, Dalar Shirinian, Kristin Voegtline, Lauren M. Osborne, Jennifer L. Payne, Liisa Hantsoo
pmc-11496889.description: BackgroundPremenstrual Syndrome (PMS) and Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder (PMDD), collectively known as Premenstrual Disorders (PMDs), cause significant distress and functional impairment, and premenstrual exacerbation (PME) affects a large proportion of women with psychiatric diagnoses. Childhood trauma is one factor that may contribute to PMD/PME risk. This study examines the relationship between childhood trauma and PMDs, PME, and non-PMD psychiatric illness.

pmc-11510453.title: Consequences of the COVID-19 Pandemic on the Incidence, Management and Outcomes of Staphylococcus aureus Bacteraemia: Experience in a Spanish Hospital
pmc-11510453.creator: Elizabeth Lorenzo-Hernández, Francisco Rivas-Ruiz, Alfonso Del Arco-Jiménez
pmc-11510453.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This work aims to assess the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the mortality and incidence of complications in patients with bacteraemia due to Staphylococcus aureus (BSA). All episodes of BSA at the Costa del Sol University Hospital (Marbella, Spain) were recorded during the acute phase of the COVID-19 pandemic (March 2020–March 2022) and compared with those in a previous period (February 2018–February 2020). Demographic, clinical and prognostic variables were recorded.

pmc-11526593.title: Impact of the CPS-EG score as a new prognostic biomarker in triple-negative breast cancer patients who received neoadjuvant chemotherapy
pmc-11526593.creator: İrem Öner, Alper Türkel, Bediz Kurt İnci, Pınar Kubilay Tolunay, Öztürk Ateş, Cengiz Karaçin
pmc-11526593.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThis study aimed to establish risk groups on the basis of CPS-EG scores, independent of pCR status, in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) patients receiving neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT) to identify the prognostic impact of the CPS-EG score.MethodsPatient characteristics included age, menopausal status, clinical stage, pathological stage, estrogen receptor (ER) expression, nuclear grade, Ki-67 proliferation index, residual cancer burden (RCB) score, HER2 status, and other tumor characteristics. The CPS-EG scoring system included clinical stage, pathological stage, ER status, and grade.

pmc-12494736.title: Digital PCR-Based characterization of a Zhonghuang 6106 soybean genomic DNA reference material for its food and feed detection
pmc-12494736.creator: Cheng Wang, Ruihuan Li, Na Liu, Xin Qi, Chao Xu, Junjin Yao, Chen Zhang, Yasi Wang, Qingkuo Lan, Yong Wang, Xin Zhao
pmc-12494736.description: The genomic DNA reference material of genetically modified soybean Zhonghuang6106, developed in this study, was prepared by extracting genomic DNA from the leaves of both homozygous transgenic soybean Zhonghuang 6106 and non-transgenic soybean Zhonghuang10, followed by proportional mixing of the genomic DNA. Eight qualified laboratories independently validated the certified reference material (CRM) using the digital polymerase chain reaction (dPCR) method.

pmc-12694345.title: Engineering Glutathione Peroxidase-Loaded Polymeric Nanogels Through a Grafting-To Route for Enhanced Enzyme Stability and Activity
pmc-12694345.creator: Suman Basak
pmc-12694345.description: Nanogels provide unique opportunities for stabilizing fragile enzymes through soft, hydrated polymer networks. Here, we report the development of a glutathione peroxidase (GPx)-loaded nanogel (GPxNG) engineered via a mild “grafting-to” epoxy–amine coupling strategy to enhance enzyme stability and antioxidant function.

pmc-13153003.title: The genetic and developmental enigma of rhizomes: crucial traits with limited understanding
pmc-13153003.creator: Hongfei Chen, Jenn M. Coughlan
pmc-13153003.description: Rhizomes, horizontal underground stems, play fundamental roles in plant persistence and perennial growth by enabling clonal propagation, resource storage, and stress resilience. Despite their ecological and agronomic importance across plant lineages, the genetic and developmental regulation of rhizomes remains poorly characterized.

pmc-13213873.title: Novel Clinical Trial Designs for Intermediate Age-Related Macular Degeneration
pmc-13213873.creator: Alessandro Berni, Mengxi Shen, Jeremy Liu, James D. Kastner, Omar S. El-Mulki, Sara Beqiri, Gissel Herrera, Omer Trivizki, Nadia K. Waheed, Dale W. Usner, Brian Levy, Robert O’Brien, Giovanni Gregori, Philip J. Rosenfeld
pmc-13213873.description: PurposeTo develop and model clinical trial designs for intermediate age-related macular degeneration (iAMD) using OCT-based structural biomarkers to define inclusion criteria and estimate sample size requirements for detecting treatment effects over 2 years.DesignRetrospective study of a prospectively acquired swept-source OCT cohort.SubjectsPatients with iAMD enrolled in a prospective natural history imaging study.MethodsTwo clinical trial designs were modeled.

pmc-13519188.title: NanoString profiling of DNA repair and apoptosis genes in testicular germ cell tumours with divergent chemotherapy outcomes
pmc-13519188.creator: Nadia Hitchen, Philippe L Bedard, Neil Winegarden, Joan Sweet, Amanda Grubb, Lynn Anson-Cartwright, Peter Chung, Padraig Warde, Malcolm Moore, Edmond M Kwan, Ben Tran
pmc-13519188.description: BackgroundPlatinum-based chemotherapy cures most patients with advanced testicular germ cell tumours (TGCTs), yet a subset develops resistance or relapse. The molecular basis of platinum sensitivity and resistance remains unclear, particularly in archival formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) samples that limit broad genomic analyses.ObjectivesTo evaluate whether differential expression of genes involved in apoptosis, DNA repair, and cell-cycle regulation distinguish platinum-resistant TGCTs.

pmc-13586904.title: Methodological Reporting Quality of Artificial Intelligence-Based Orthopedic Studies: A Literature Analysis
pmc-13586904.creator: Gündüz Ercan KUTLUAY, Ahmet Furkan KUMRU
pmc-13586904.description: ObjectiveWe set out to examine how completely artificial intelligence (AI)-based orthopedic studies report their methods.MethodsA PubMed search covering 2023-2025 was run with a predefined strategy. Screening of titles, abstracts and full texts left 280 eligible papers, and 200 of these were drawn at random for scoring.

pmc-13632234.title: Enhanced antibiofilm activity of ciprofloxacin-loaded quatsomal gel against Multidrug-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA)
pmc-13632234.creator: Jianguo Shi, Zanib Farid, Sanaa Anjum, Syed Tatheer Alam Naqvi, Muhammad Arfat Yameen
pmc-13632234.description: BackgroundMRSA biofilms remain a major challenge in clinical settings because they reduce antibiotics susceptibility and contribute to persistent infections. This current study was designed to evaluate quatsomal gel as a proof-of-concept topical ciprofloxacin delivery platform aimed at enhancing localized antimicrobial and antibiofilm activity against MRSA.

pmc-3969247.description: Peer-reviewed research article (PubMed Central). This study aims to (1) elucidate whether the Hawthorne effect exists, (2) explore under what conditions, and (3) estimate the size of any such effect.
